nginx_access_log_path.description: Path to the main access log file.

nginx_client_body_buffer_size.description: Buffer size for client request bodies before spilling to disk.

nginx_client_max_body_size.description: Maximum allowed size of client request body (e.g., '10m' for 10 MB).

nginx_conf_d_path.description: Directory containing additional site-specific configuration files (*.conf).

nginx_custom_servers.description: List of custom server blocks to include inline (use for monitoring endpoints, fallback servers, or module-specific configs).

description.description: Human-readable description of this server block.

index.description: List of index files to try in order.

locations.description: List of location blocks for URL path routing.

auth_basic.description: Enable HTTP Basic Auth; value sets the realm string.

auth_basic_user_file.description: Path to .htpasswd file for auth users.

extra_config.description: Custom directives for nginx-extras modules (e.g., auth_request, limit_req, etc.).

path.description: URL path or regex pattern to match (e.g., '/api/', '^~ /static/').

root.description: Override document root for this location.
Document root directory for this server.

server_name.description: List of server names or wildcard patterns (e.g., ['example.com', '*.example.com']).

ssl_certificate.description: Path to the SSL certificate file.

ssl_certificate_key.description: Path to the SSL private key file.

nginx_default_type.description: Default MIME type for responses when type cannot be determined.

nginx_error_log_level.description: Log level for errors (debug, info, notice, warn, error, crit, alert, emerg).

nginx_error_log_path.description: Path to the global error log file.

nginx_events_use.description: Event notification mechanism (e.g., epoll for Linux, kqueue for BSD).

nginx_events_worker_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections each worker can handle. Higher values increase capacity but require more file descriptors.

nginx_group.description: System group for NGINX worker processes.

nginx_gzip_compression_level.description: Gzip compression level (1–9). Higher = better compression but more CPU.

nginx_gzip_min_length.description: Minimum response size (bytes) required to enable gzip compression.

nginx_gzip_types.description: MIME types to compress with gzip. Applies only to responses with matching Content-Type headers.

nginx_keepalive_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for keep-alive connections with clients.

nginx_mimetypes_file.description: Path to the file containing MIME type definitions.

nginx_open_file_cache_inactive.description: Time after which cached entries become inactive if not accessed.

nginx_open_file_cache_max.description: Maximum number of open files in the cache.

nginx_open_file_cache_min.description: Minimum number of accesses before a file is cached.

nginx_open_file_cache_valid.description: Interval for validating cached file metadata.

nginx_pid_file.description: Path to the PID file storing the main NGINX process ID.

nginx_sendfile.description: Enable/disable sendfile(2) for high-performance static file delivery.

nginx_tcp_nopush.description: Enable TCP_NOPUSH (or TCP_CORK) to send full TCP packets for improved network efficiency.

nginx_user.description: System user account under which NGINX worker processes run for security isolation.

nginx_worker_processes.description: Number of worker processes. Set to 'auto' for automatic CPU core detection (use 1 as safe default; advanced users may override via string).
